title: Early Termination of a LandlordGuard Installment Plan: Service Charges in a Pay-Off
content:
**Rule.** A pay-off of the current term of a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy includes pay-off installment fees that depend on the returned payments posted on the policy in the 12 calendar months up to the pay-off date:

- with two or more, every installment of the current term not yet billed carries the tier's installment service charge;
- with exactly one, only the next unbilled installment carries it;
- with none, no fee is charged on unbilled installments.

A pay-off made after repeated returned payments ends the installment plan on the insured's default rather than by the insured's choice, so the service charges the plan would have carried stay earned.

The pay-off installment fees are the amount included in the pay-off for service charges on installments not yet billed.

| Returned payments posted on the policy, 12 calendar months up to the pay-off date | Pay-off installment fees |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | the tier's charge for every unbilled installment of the term |
| exactly 1 | the tier's charge for one installment, where at least one is unbilled |
| none | nothing |

## Tier installment service charge (USD)

| DP-1 Basic | DP-2 Broad | DP-3 Special | DP-3 Special Plus | DP-3 Premier | DP-3 Portfolio |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6.00 | 6.00 | 5.00 | 5.00 | 4.00 | 0.00 |

## Worked cases (hypothetical quarterly term on DP-3 Special, two installments not yet billed)

| Returned payments in the 12 months | Pay-off installment fees |
|---|---|
| 3 | two installments at 5.00, that is 10.00 USD |
| 1 | one installment at 5.00, that is 5.00 USD |
| 0 | 0.00 |

On an annual term already billed in full no installment is unbilled, so the fees are nothing whatever the returned payments.
